name: Ilford Delta 400 Professional
notes: Characteristic curve: x axis is RELATIVE log exposure (frame 0 to 4.5, no absolute lux-seconds, no Log H Ref), y is density, frame bottom = 0 (gridlines every 0.5, labelled 1.0 and 2.0). Densitometry type is not stated; balance 'daylight' is the light of the ISO 400/27 speed rating ('to daylight'; the ISO speed was measured in ID-11 at 20C).

One curve only: roll film in ILFORD ID-11 stock, 8 min at 24C/75F (not 20C), intermittent agitation. Traced as v; base+fog about 0.29 as read (high compared with the other Ilford sheets, probably the warm development), curve ends at relative log exposure about 4.35 with density about 2.3 and a flattening shoulder.

Spectral sensitivity: 'Wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)' drawn as a line curve on a 'Sensitivity' axis with ticks 0.5 and 1.0 only; traced as sensitivity/v with the numbers as printed (relative; linear or log not stated). The frame bottom is about -0.11 on that scale; the curve runs about 353-698 nm, so it extends to longer wavelengths than HP5 Plus.

Page 5 has contrast-time graphs (contrast index against development time for ID-11, Microphen, Perceptol, DD-X at 20C and 24C); they are not characteristic curves and are not traced. No document code (footer 'Page n of 7, Nov 2018'), no granularity figure.
